spans.s:
मृध् 1. मृध्, cl. 1. P. A. मर्धति, -ते,
मर्धितुम्, (Ved.) to kill, injure, hurt;
to contemn, neglect, forget, disregard, be disgusted
with (with acc.); to be moist; to moisten; [cf. pro-
bably Gr. μαλθακός; Goth. maurthr; Angl. Sax.
mordher, mordhor; Old Germ. multjan.]

2. मृध्, त्, f., Ved. (according to Sāy.) combat,
fight, battle; one who contemns or injures; an ad-
versary, foe, enemy.

मृध, अम्, n. combat, fight, war, battle; (said
to be also अस्, m.)

मृधस्, अस्, n., Ved. war, battle; contempt, indif-
ference; मृधस्-कृ, to disdain, contemn, injure.

मृध्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one who injures, an
enemy; (आणि), n. pl. disdain, contempt, abuse,
insult, contumely.
—मृध्र-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, Ved.
speaking injuriously or contumeliously, insulting.
